description: This file defines the ProgramWorkflow class, which models workflows within a program in the OpenMRS healthcare platform. It includes properties, constructors, and methods for managing workflow states, transitions, and related entities.

classes.name: ProgramWorkflow
classes.description: Represents a workflow within a program, managing its states and transitions, typically used in patient management workflows in OpenMRS.

methods.name: addState
methods.description: Adds a new state to the workflow and sets its parent ProgramWorkflow.

methods.name: removeState
methods.description: Removes a state from the workflow and nullifies its parent reference.

methods.name: retireState
methods.description: Marks a given state as retired.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Retrieves a state by its ID, concept, or name.

methods.name: getStates
methods.description: Retrieves all states, optionally including retired states.

methods.name: getSortedStates
methods.description: Returns all states sorted by concept name using natural sorting.

methods.name: getPossibleNextStates
methods.description: Returns a list of possible next states from the current patient program state.

methods.name: isLegalTransition
methods.description: Checks if transition from one state to another is allowable.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the ProgramWorkflow.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this workflow.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier for this workflow.

methods.name: getNonRetiredStateCount
methods.description: Returns the count of states that are not retired.
